title: Consolidated Water Receives 25-Year Exclusive Retail Water License for Grand Cayman Operations as Tourism Momentum Continues
summary: GEORGE TOWN, Cayman Islands, June 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Consolidated Water Co. Ltd. (NASDAQ Global Select Market: CWCO), a leading designer, builder and operator of advanced water treatment plants, today announced that its Cayman Islands retail water utility, Cayman Water Company Limited, has received a new license from the Utility Regulation and Competition Office of the Cayman Islands (“OfReg”) to provide potable water service to customers in its licensed service areas on Grand Cayman. The new license establishes a modern, long-term regulatory framework for the company’s regulated retail water operations following an extended period of negotiations with OfReg and its predecessor. The license has a stated commencement date of August 1, 2026, and, subject to its terms and conditions, continues for a period of 25 years from that date.
